subject.title: [Feature]: Always-visible build identity chip in sidebar footer (sha + build age + branch)

question: Should permanent sidebar chrome show the Control UI artifact commit and age while keeping gateway checkout branch state separate?
rationale: The issue changes the information hierarchy of a newly introduced UI and the current architecture deliberately sources artifact and gateway identity separately, so implementation should wait for explicit product semantics.

options.title: Separate artifact chip
options.body: Show the UI short commit and relative age as a muted About link, while retaining the gateway branch strip as a distinct warning.

options.title: Combine identities
options.body: Use one branch, commit, and age chip even though UI artifact and gateway checkout values can describe different builds.

options.title: Retain current surfaces
options.body: Keep artifact identity in About and the dev tooltip, with only gateway branch state persistently visible.

recommendation.title: Separate artifact chip
recommendation.body: Show the UI short commit and relative age as a muted About link, while retaining the gateway branch strip as a distinct warning.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored every current build-identity surface and opened the follow-up, making them the clearest available owner for the product choice.
